findings.failure_mode: The PB-TASK-BLOCKED ledger statement overreaches: set_task_blocked calls the fence-blind _set_status first, so a fenced `## Status` example is clobbered while the real status stays stale; the guarantee text must scope the hazard to the Blocked/Handoff splice (opus).

Loose fence closer: a ```lang line inside a fence is treated as the closer (CommonMark requires a whitespace-only closer, and a backtick info string is not an opener), so the fence-aware section locator mis-splices task.md (codex:sol#1, codex:terra#1).
Two divergent fence scanners (_iter_nonfenced vs _closed_fence_line_indices) disagree on fence rules; opener/closer rules unified here, full convergence parked (opus, self-flagged low-confidence).
A 4-space-indented `## ` line (indented code, not a heading) ends a real section in the span locator (codex:terra#2; parked, writer and reader agree).
